items.item_text: Degree in information technology, informatics, public health or related fields.

An advanced educational qualification, Ph.D, Graduate Business Degree (e.g., Masters of Business, Technology or Public Administration) or equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred.
High-level professional experience in communication, marketing, public relations or related field.
Extensive experience in communicating to public health stakeholders verbally and/or in writing.
Experience in creating and managing a team environment.

Experience in informatics, including work on interoperability between disparate information systems, and application of knowledge of hardware, software (including business rules and algorithms) and network infrastructure.
40% - Leadership and Oversight of Electronic Laboratory Data Exchange (LDX) System
25% - Quality Assurance and Compliance of Laboratory Information System
15% - Oversight of System Administration, Training & Technical Support
Ability to interact diplomatically with diverse personalities and to exercise judgment and tact in interactions with faculty, staff, students and the public.
Ability to exercise initiative, originality, and judgement in applying established principles and practices to new and innovative opportunities.
Ability to represent the University at the highest levels and in public forums with professionalism and integrity.
Proven strong political acumen skills and ability to apply in diverse, complex organization.
Proven ability to apply high ethical standards to business practices and decision-making.

Proven ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential issues that require independent judgement and strict discretion, and maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive, confidential and/or privileged information.
